PRESS RELEASE: Alaska Policy Forum Elects Ray Kreig Board President | Alaska Policy Forum
item.description: Anchorage, Alaska (June 9, 2025) – Alaska Policy Forum (APF) has elected Ray Kreig as the President of the Board of Directors. Kreig was a co-founder of Alaska Policy Forum in 2009. A civil engineer, he also brings a wealth of expertise in public lands, labor unions, energy policy and performance benchmarking to the board.
